armLabels.A: Strong retained incumbent with legitimate tools/caches
armLabels.B: Searchable registry with equivalent skills, admission, freshness and evidence
armLabels.D: Equally accepted strongest direct conventional alternative; no forced native history integration

conditions.interpretation: Inherited favorable deployment region; zero integration friction is assumed.

calibration.tariffBasis: Explicit inherited compute sensitivity, not measured invoice or empirical cost bound.
calibration.zeroCreditMeaning: No measured human/customer saving; zero economic credit does not assert zero human work.
calibration.machineScope: Mean inclusive CPU difference on15primary paired-composition missions only; three designed root-scope stresses are separate. Measured tools/caches/verification included. Elapsed time is not human attention.
calibration.sharedOverheadRule: Measured inclusive CPU beyond per-mission rows is allocated uniformly across18fresh outcomes, then included in15primary mean. Designed-stress row CPU never enters the primary mean. Cohort labels must match across arms.

alternativeInterpretation: Adaptive policy can retain the incumbent after paid discovery; each completed composition is also evaluated as existing research replay. Registry/graph full oneoff costs are deducted once even if outside the modeled enterprise. No-investment spends no new construction and preserves available reserves. Existing initial asset maintenance remains charged by the inherited simulator.
inference: 24 paired conditional worlds per cell; report all means, quantiles, downside counts and descriptive Monte Carlo intervals; no observed-demand, equilibrium, or unconditional probability claim.
stoppingRule: Exactly frozen 48 cells x24 seeds; no parameter/price/horizon substitution. Retain partial outputs on any invariant/budget failure; no automatic restart.
financialQualification: Actual composed pipeline must be technically admitted under fixture policy, used on all accepted confirmation missions, identified by source/evidence hash, funded from prior operating resources, and repay complete incremental cost within52weeks. A graph root or technical admission alone is insufficient.

directAlternative.scope: Matched primary production and deterministic assumed-tariff/break-even comparison; no additional strategic campaign.
directAlternative.adoptionRule: The native A/B/C financial comparison is conditional on native-history requirements. It cannot establish global graph superiority over D. Equivalent faster D must be disclosed; complete D integration/adoption costs are unknown unless measured, so global admission remains unresolved.
